resources.implementation: memory mapped sparse per-cell counts; no Seurat load, no ranking matrix; serial small bulk computations; large tasks must wait

gene_mapping.primary: author gene symbol; exact org.Hs.eg.db SYMBOL then uniquely mapped ALIAS; Ensembl fallback unique SYMBOL only
gene_mapping.unmapped_background: retain unique original identifiers, never restrict to HVG

bulk.counts: edgeR TMM log2 CPM prior.count=1, retain full provided feature background including zero genes
bulk.microarray: author RMA/quantile/within-cohort ComBat gene matrix; no second log or ComBat
bulk.standardization: one cohort enrollment mean and sample SD; same z across all models

epi.method: verified stored average-tie AUCell-like, not official randomized AUCell
epi.patient_primary: confirmed/verified IDs only; derived/provisional excluded from patient inference
epi.patient_effect: equal-weight mean sample Fisher-z then tanh
epi.overall_effect: equal patient mean Fisher-z then tanh
epi.P: two-sided exact sign test H0 P(patient rho>0 | nonzero)=0.5; independent verified patients
epi.adjustment: rank each score and each log1p(depth), S.Score, G2M.Score with average ties within sample; OLS intercept; Pearson correlation residuals
epi.sensitivity: replace nCount_RNA with nFeature_RNA; original CNV malignant_like_main subset; four gene-set sensitivities
epi.unverified: sample descriptions only; no pooled cell P

cell_lines.aggregation: arithmetic mean of RNA replicates per line-state then paired delta
cell_lines.test: two-sided exact sign test, zeros excluded
cell_lines.CI: 10000 bootstrap entire cell-line backgrounds, mean delta percentile; n=5 exploratory

clinical.unknown: three-state rules in user request; no surgery/unevaluable -> unknown
clinical.inclusion: pretreatment tumor; strict documented cisplatin NAC only; induction separate
clinical.fallback_212810: author-defined NAC all cohort if patient regimens unavailable; no strict cisplatin claim
clinical.fallback_169455: NAC with unknown regimen descriptive sensitivity only, strict primary BLOCKED
clinical.model: binomial glm logit MP10_z; two-sided Wald P and 95% CI
clinical.penalty_trigger: nonconvergence, separation, extreme fitted probability (<1e-8 or >1-1e-8), beta SE>10 -> Firth with profile likelihood CI if available; otherwise mark not estimable

FDR.epi: BH two primary original UP/DN patient tests
FDR.clinical: BH two strict-cohort common primary endpoint tests; unavailable tests remain NA with family n=2
FDR.cell_lines: BH all 3 sign tests, CisR primary

independence: discovery sources CNP0000460,HRA003620,InhouseData,PRJNA662018,GSE326225; none of three external accessions present in discovery metadata; historical selection outside available records cannot be excluded
